caption: A garden parasol is tilted in bright sun, and its round shadow slides across the patio.

sa.check: Its shadow slides across the patio.
The tilt comes first and the slide follows.

pc.expect: The shadow moves only as the canopy tilts.
pc.fail: It slides with the parasol still; or moves before the tilt; or keeps moving after.

pc.expect: The shadow keeps roughly its round shape and does not detach from the pole's base.
pc.fail: It becomes a different shape; or detaches from the pole; or splits.

pc.expect: The shadow moves opposite to the tilt of the canopy and stays on the side away from the sun.
pc.fail: It moves the same way as the tilt; or lies toward the sun; or it is missing in sunlight.

pc.expect: The canopy is taut fabric on ribs.
pc.fail: It is rigid like a plate; or floats off; or tears.
A second shadow appears; or the parasol vanishes; or the shadow becomes solid.

pc.expect: The parasol and the patio stay the same, and the shadow stays dark.
pc.fail: The canopy changes colour; or the shadow turns coloured; or the patio changes.

note: The hand tilting is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
